Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

BONE PLATE, SHERMAN TYPE 



( Reaffirmed 1992) 



1. Scope — Dimensions and requirements for Sherman type bone plates to suit screws of 3*5 mm 
diameter used in orthopaedic surgery.

FIG. I BONE PLATE. SHERMAN TYPE 



3. Material — Shall be according to 3-of IS : 5347-1969*. 

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish — Each plate shali be pressed in one-piece, and shall be 
symmetrical and well-balanced. The holes shall be uniform in shape and situated on the centre line of the 
plate. 

4.1 Each plate shall be free from cracks, draw marks, pits, burrs, surface contamination and impregnated 
foreign particles. The plate shall be passivated and polished bright to give a mirror or satin finish. 

5. Corrosion Resistance Test — Shall be according to 6.1 of IS : 5347-1969*. 

6. Radiological Test — Shall be according to 6.2 of IS : 5347-1969*. 

7. Marking— Shallbe according to 5.1 of IS : 5347-1969*. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available from Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi I. 

8. Packing — The plates may be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. However, 
it is recommended that each plate may be wrapped in poly^ethyiene bag or in wax paper and then packed 
in cartons. 



♦General requirements of metal surgical implants.
